name: Somezuki Uruu
source:
[spoiler]Name: Uru Somezuki
Sex: Male
Age: 29 (Past) | 35 (Present)
Birthday: February 29
Profession: Unemployed
Likes: Tokiko, Naix's Teachings
Dislikes: Jin, Chikara, Those Who Impede the Plan
Hobbies: Fulfilling Tokiko's Prophecy, Journaling
Skills: Knowledgeably in Molecular Biology, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Mechanics

The true identity of Tearer. When he was 6, he was kidnapped by [url=/c108950]Chikara[/url] and [url=/c108944]Tokiko[/url] from Aioen. He was held in the basement of Horadori Institute and constantly had the organs in his right half taken away, ultimately his face as well.

[From the in-game character description]

Uru encountered [url=/c86548]Amame Doi[/url] in the Past and believes her to be his "destiny." Six years later, he presents The Nirvana Initiative to an [url=/c112125]older Amame[/url], who kills him as revenge for her [url=/c107324]father[/url]'s murder. Uru, the main antagonist, is the first body featured in the game.[/spoiler]
